jobs.title: Business Development Strategist (Remote)
jobs.description:
Lightning Labs is looking for a Business Development Strategist who is passionate about bringing bitcoin to the next billion people by expanding Lightning's reach across new companies and industries. This role will be focused on identifying businesses that will help grow the Lightning Network, building relationships with the relevant leaders, and communicating the business value of Lightning to them. The ideal candidate will have previous experience in the finance industry, a fintech or payments company, or in a business development role for a high-growth startup, have a strong understanding of the technologies behind bitcoin and Lightning, and have excellent writing skills.



Responsibilities: 

 - Strategy
   
   - Collaborate with leadership on business development strategy, from aligning on promising regions and verticals to identifying target companies to tailoring specific value propositions for those companies.
   
   - Understand and clearly communicate how higher level shifts in the global financial market will impact a multi-asset Lightning Network and stablecoin adoption.

 - Business Development
   
   - Source new potential customers, from new Lightning-first entrepreneurs to existing bitcoin companies and non-bitcoin companies that want to add Lightning support to their apps.
   
   - Support existing customers by being a point of contact for technical questions or feature requests, and by being able to explain new features and the business-related impacts of upgrading. 
   
   - Understand customers’ business goals, and connect them with ecosystem participants that may help them achieve them.

 - Communications
   
   - Write compelling, high-quality thought pieces to drive awareness and education around the Lightning Network, Lightning Labs, and its products.
   
   - Support funnel growth activities, such as blog posts, press releases, engagement across social outlets, and community events.
   
   - Build organic awareness and grow engagement across community platforms such as Slack, Telegram, Twitter, etc. 



Location: Global and remote. Proximity to US time zones would be ideal.



Requirements:

 - Passion for bitcoin, Lightning, and the mission of bringing financial freedom to the world

 - At least 3-5 years of experience in a business development, strategy, financial, or other relevant role

 - Attention to detail and strong writing and editing skills

 - Creative thinker who can effortlessly communicate technical concepts to non-technical audiences

 - Eagerness to try new things and to be energized by creative challenges

 - Ability to work autonomously and collaborate across time zones

 - Fast learner with a strong ability to reach out to new audiences



Preferred:

 - Track record of public writings regarding the global financial or payments markets, ideally with an emphasis on bitcoin, Lightning, or stablecoins

 - Ability to build relationships particularly with entrepreneurs and developers in emerging markets (LATAM, Asia, Sub-Saharan Africa)

 - Familiarity with the Lightning community and a technical understanding of bitcoin and Lightning

jobs.title: Business Development Lead (Remote)
jobs.description:
Lightning Labs is looking for a Business Development Lead who is passionate about bringing bitcoin to the next billion people by expanding Lightning’s reach across enterprise and fintech ecosystems. This role will focus on go-to-market strategy, monetization, and high-leverage selling, translating Lightning’s technical advantages into concrete business outcomes for payment processors, exchanges, fintech companies, AI startups, agents, and large merchants. The ideal candidate has a strong track record in enterprise sales and strategy at a fintech, payments, AI, or infrastructure company, deep familiarity with bitcoin and the Lightning Network (including stablecoin use cases), and exceptional executive communication skills.



Responsibilities:

 - Strategy & OKRs
   
   - Set and own high-level BD OKRs across target regions, verticals, and segments; work with the BD team to translate company strategy into a quarterly plan with measurable outcomes.
   
   - Identify the most promising use cases and companies for Lightning, agentic payments, and stablecoins; prioritize accounts and partners with the highest network growth potential.
   
   - Collaborate with product and engineering on roadmap priorities and feature timelines given feedback from external customers and developers.

 - Monetization and Sales
   
   - Design pricing, packaging, and deal structures aligned to product value (e.g., volume-based, tiered, usage-based, partner revenue shares).
   
   - Personally lead and close strategic, multi-stakeholder deals with exchanges, AI companies, PSPs, wallets, fintechs, miners, and enterprise adopters.
   
   - Stand up a lightweight forecast and pipeline cadence (coverage, stage definitions, velocity, win/loss) in partnership with Finance—without turning the team into a quota-only sales org.

 - Developer Community and Market Development
   
   - Source and prioritize net-new partners and channels; develop joint GTM with key ecosystem players (processors, liquidity providers, compliance vendors, custody, and infra).
   
   - Architect distribution flywheels (developer adoption → merchant enablement → payment volume) and unlock high-value corridors.
   
   - Connect customers’ business goals with the right technical integrations, integration partners, and liquidity resources.

 - Executive Communications
   
   - Craft crisp, executive-ready materials (narratives, pitch decks, requests for proposals (RFPs), board/partner updates) that tie Lightning’s capabilities to business impact.
   
   - Represent Lightning Labs at senior-level meetings, conferences, and media/analyst engagements; contribute thought leadership that advances the category.



Location: Global and remote. Must be willing to work on US time zones.



Requirements:

 - 7–10+ years in business development, strategic partnerships, and/or solution-oriented enterprise sales at a fintech, payments, AI, or other relevant tech company.

 - Demonstrated track record of crafting GTM strategy and closing complex, multi-party commercial agreements.

 - Strong technical and product fluency: able to translate bitcoin/Lightning concepts (routing, liquidity, settlement, Taproot Assets/stablecoins, agentic payments) into clear commercial outcomes.

 - Fluency with frontier LLMs and AI tools and willingness to integrate them at every level.

 - Comfortable leading a small team and operating as a senior individual contributor.

 - Exceptional written and verbal communication; confident with C-suite, product, legal, and technical stakeholders.

 - Analytical, data-driven decision-maker; comfortable building ROI/TCO models and deal economics.

 - Ability to work autonomously across time zones; willing to travel for key customers and events.



Preferred:

 - Public writings or talks on global payments, bitcoin/Lightning, AI, or stablecoins.

 - Deep network among exchanges, AI companies, PSPs, wallets, fintechs, and payment facilitators—especially in LATAM, Asia, or Sub-Saharan Africa.

 - Experience launching or scaling developer-led distribution and partner channels.

 - Familiarity with compliance considerations in crypto/payments and how they affect GTM.
